PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (21.0, 14.0, 25.0),      # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),         # input pair L (flicker area)
    "Itail": (11.0e-6, 8e-6, 13e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.2, 0.5, 3.0),         # PMOS mirror L (flicker area)
    "gmid7": (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),      # output PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # output PMOS L
    "Iout":  (16e-6, 13e-6, 18e-6),   # output stage current
    "Cc":    (0.38e-12, 0.25e-12, 0.7e-12),
    "gmidb": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),      # NMOS mirrors gm/Id
    "Lb":    (2.0, 0.8, 3.0),         # NMOS mirror L (tail impedance -> CMRR)
    "gmidc": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Itail = p["Itail"]
    Iout = p["Iout"]
    imax = 37.2e-6 - iref
    if Itail + Iout > imax:
        Iout = max(imax - Itail, 10e-6)
    Ih = Itail / 2
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Lc = 0.5

    # ---- input pair with body effect ----
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.22, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.17)
    vd1 = vtail + 0.22
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=vd1 - vtail, vsb=vtail)

    # ---- PMOS mirror ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=1.1)
    for _ in range(2):
        m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = m3
    vdd1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- NMOS cascodes ----
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], Lc, Ih, vds=max(vdd1 - vd1, 0.12), vsb=vd1)
    vcasn = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # ---- output stage ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    # ---- NMOS bias mirrors (same L, gm/Id -> matched Vgs); Mb sized at its own Vds ----
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    for _ in range(3):
        mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Itail, vds=vtail)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], Iout, vds=0.9)

    Rcas = max((vcasn - mb.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("Rcas", "ibias", "nb", Rcas)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1c", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2c", "x", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "a2", Cc)

    # ---- first-order predictions (calibrated against iter-1 sim) ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / (mc.gds * m1.gds + 1e-30)
    g1 = m4.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = 0.78 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + mc.cdd + 5e-15
    fp2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * (cl + Cc)) / (2 * PI)
    fcas = mc.gm / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 2e-15))
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fcas)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir))
    slew = 0.9 * min(Itail / Cc, Iout / (cl + Cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.8 / slew + 6 * tau
    # flicker-dominated noise, scaled from iter-1 (494 nV at L1=0.8, Ih~5.25u)
    noise_1k = 494e-9 * math.sqrt((0.8 * 0.8) / (p["L1"] * p["L1"])) * math.sqrt(5.25e-6 / Ih)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / (m5.gds + 1e-30) / 8.0  # empirical derating from iter-1
    swing = vdd - (max(m7.vdsat, 0.08) + max(m8.vdsat, 0.08))
    power = vdd * (iref + Itail + Iout)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(A0) - 6,
        "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
